Current experiment · September 2026

The manager is running while the architecture is measured.

A project-specific Hermes PM bot is working through the TokenUsage tracker. The immediate question is whether persistent management saves attention while preserving correct project state.

CHANGE POLICY

Observe before reshaping PM.

Proposed plugin changes are documented and held until the current setup produces enough real operating evidence.

Observed

Hermes maintained the manager-only boundary and delegated implementation instead of coding.

Running now

It is moving through tracker tickets and beginning diagnosis when a ticket returns with an issue.

Being measured

Recovery across tickets, state continuity, attention saved, and context consumed per accepted outcome.

Held

PM plugin changes remain proposals until the trial reveals the actual pressure points.

What would count as success

More accepted outcomes per hour of Joe’s attention.

  • The bot selects the correct ready work without broad rescanning
  • Failures become bounded diagnosis and repair loops
  • Receipts remain sufficient for later review and recovery
  • Questions arrive consolidated at real decision points
  • A fresh session can resume from the tracker and durable records
